_doc: wotnow ADK agent registry. Every Gemini call in the app goes through one of these skills. Change instructions, temperature, review steps or guardrails HERE (and in instructions/*.md, rules.json), not in Python.

write_scenario.description: Writes a 'What would you do?' scenario with a hidden rubric, from the expert's fact cards.

write_poll.description: Writes a 4-option poll with one best answer.

write_scam_legit.description: Writes a realistic message and whether it is a scam.

review_post.description: Second agent that checks every AI-written post against the fact cards and child-safety rules before it can be published.

judge.description: Decides which rubric points a student's answer covers. Never scores (code does).

moderate.description: Classifies a student reply before other students can see it.

expert_reply.description: The expert replies to a top student answer.

local_alert.description: Turns live weather and air quality into a student-friendly city alert.

live_quiz.description: Hosts a 5-question live quiz from the expert's fact cards.

parent_coach.description: Turns what a child missed into dinner-table conversation starters for parents.

audiences.junior: Classes 3-5 (age 8-10). Very simple words, short sentences, gentle situations, no injuries shown.
audiences.middle: Classes 6-8 (age 11-13). Simple, clear English. Realistic but not frightening.
audiences.senior: Classes 9-12 (age 14-17). Realistic situations, can include more responsibility.
audiences.all: School students from Class 3 to Class 12. Keep it simple and friendly.

tasks.scenario: Write ONE 'What would you do?' scenario. Build 3-5 rubric items whose weights sum to 100; every item must cite a card id from the FACT CARDS. List dangerous actions a learner might wrongly suggest.
tasks.poll: Write ONE multiple-choice poll with exactly 4 options and one clearly best answer from the fact cards. Make wrong options common real-life mistakes.
tasks.myth_fact: Write ONE myth-or-fact statement that many people believe or doubt. Answer must be 'myth' or 'fact' per the cards.
tasks.scam_legit: Write ONE realistic message (SMS, pop-up or chat) and say whether it is a 'scam' or 'legit', per the cards. Never include real brand names, real phone numbers or working links; mask numbers with •.
